description: Quantcast offline conversion batches on the exact documented endpoint. Checks the URL account, POST transport, JSON array, required event name and user identity alternatives, optional timestamps, IPs and conversion metadata. Account enablement, billing currency and browser token authenticity require external context.

params.name: a
params.description: The endpoint requires the Quantcast account ID starting with p-.
The documented request is a JSON array of conversions.
Each conversion is an object.

params.name: name
params.description: The documented event name is required and remains open.

params.name: user
params.description: Every conversion requires user identity.

params.name: user.token
params.description: Opaque browser token. Either this or external_id is required.

params.name: user.external_id
params.description: Caller identity. Either this or token is required.

params.name: user.client_user_agent
params.description: Optional source user agent.

params.name: user.client_ip
params.description: Optional source IP literal.

params.name: time
params.description: Optional Unix epoch seconds or milliseconds. Neither unit nor a freshness window is guessed.

params.name: url
params.description: Optional source page URL.

params.name: referer
params.description: Optional referring page URL.

params.name: event
params.description: Optional conversion metadata.

params.name: event.labels
params.description: Labels are an open string array.

params.name: event.labels[]
params.description: Each event label is a string.

params.name: event.order_id
params.description: Optional order identity.

params.name: event.revenue
params.description: Revenue is a JSON number in the account billing currency.

params.name: event.product_category
params.description: Optional category string.

rules.message: Provide a populated user token or external_id.

params.name: method
params.description: The documented transport uses these methods.

params.name: body
params.description: The captured entity uses this root shape.

params.name: content_type
params.description: The published JSON transport uses application/json.
